what: thought-swap workspace (research/runners/_gnw_neural_swap_intention_derisk.py) re-calibrated by its own rules on the stable integrator (SIM_STABLE_INTEGRATION=1); every value chosen on the isolated organ on dev seeds 7 and 8, never on a reply
integrator_finding: on the old integrator at the production constants the workspace ignition knee (2000 -> 2500 pA, seed 7) is the drive at which 112-118 of 300 workspace cells leave the valid membrane range and the 1/3 ignited rate is that runaway; on the stable integrator weight 34 with thal 700 is depolarization block / spontaneous all-pattern activation and no weight 5-60 or normalization 0-64 gives a selective sustained ignition

w_rec.rule: lowest recurrent weight whose up-state is steady (no relaxation oscillation) at the chosen normalization; knee between 4.0 (bursty, 0.047) and 4.5 (steady); 6.5 gives the sustained plateau 0.084 on seeds 7 and 8

norm_ws_w.rule: largest norm_pool->workspace weight with a steady up-state: 16, 8 and 6 give a ~60-step relaxation oscillation (about half the organ's read windows fall below half the plateau); <= 4 steady

thal_tonic_pa.rule: largest thalamic support with no spontaneous ignition over 1000 steps on both seeds (50 pA: seed 8 ignites by itself at ~600 steps); thal pool rate is integrator-independent (700 pA: 0.097 old, 0.101 stable)

solo_plateau.rule: the measured ignited plateau at (6.5, 4, 25) on the stable integrator; the ignition criterion stays IGNITE_FRAC (0.5) x plateau = 0.042, scoped to the swap organ (the global-stop workspace shares Rung-2's SOLO_PLATEAU and is not re-calibrated here)

establish_pa.rule: the production ratio of establishment drive to ignition knee (8000 / 2500 = 3.2) applied to the stable knee (300 pA sub, 400 pA ignites): 3.2 x 400

w_ws_occ.rule: conserve the occupancy read's input (weight x plateau): 8 x (1/3) / 0.084 = 31.7

w_pat_pred.rule: the same conservation for the held-content prediction read (mirrors ws->occ)

w_occ_gate.rule: the vacancy veto knee: occupied-gate rate 0.215/0.199 at 20 (no veto), 0.093/0.077 at 40, 0.044/0.037 at 80 (empty gate ~0.19); 80 is where the veto saturates; no inversion up to 160 on the stable integrator

w_gate_ws.rule: the gate primitive (empty admits, held vetoes, self survives) holds for 1-8 on both seeds and fails at 16 (s7) / 32 (s8) and at the production 100; 1 fails the swap on seed 7 (newcomer 0.037); 4 is the middle of the admissible 2-8

timing_window.rule: the organ's stated rule is 3 ignition periods; an ignited neuron spikes every 3 steps on the old integrator (9 = 3 spikes) and every 1/0.084 = 11.9 steps on the stable one (3 spikes = 36); a read-only timing instrument, not used by production replies

unchanged.rule: the mismatch detector reads 0.154 (salient) / 0.035-0.038 (non-salient) on stable, so the salient boost reaches the 0.16 cap and the non-salient boost stays ~0.06; the eviction collapse knee on stable is 0.06-0.10 (held <= 0.05 s7, <= 0.08 s8; non-monotone above)

organ_go_gate.production_stable_integrator_s7_s8: fails 9 of 11 gate checks (never ignites at the production threshold)
organ_go_gate.recal_stable_timing_window_9_dev1_15: GO 4/15; every other check passes 15/15; the 11 failures are timing only (incumbent and newcomer co-ignited 3-15 steps)
organ_go_gate.recal_stable_timing_window_36_dev1_15: GO 12/15; seeds 1, 6, 12 fail timing only (co-ignition 3, 15, 2 steps); every other check passes 15/15
